set.body: Scope: PRD Phases 0-2. Freeze an exact committed baseline and every live numerical reconstruction and LNA transform route; resolve D1-D4 and D6-D10; establish response as an internal-dependency-free kernel with primitive ordered indices, neutral geometry/topology references, a directly owned row-major Double ResponseBlock, typed PlannedRead composition, and axis-keyed capability conformance; then split pure ArchiveRevision from resource-backed OpenArchive and PayloadExecutor. Close only when the frozen compatibility corpus is green, no response tensor or mutable-buffer escape exists, response imports no image/surface/graph/archive/latent/dataset module, unknown representations remain inspectable, mixed-axis receipts are honest, and JVM/Scala.js resource closure is proven on success, failure, and cancellation.
